issues: The play-cost reduction ability is encoded with timing "fanfare", but "When playing this card ... this card costs 9 less to play" must be a play-time cost-modification ability, not a Fanfare trigger. Encode it as a passive/while-in-hand-or-playing cost reduction gated by paying the banish cost.
The printed keywords Storm, Bane, and Ward are duplicated in both `keywords` and a passive `passiveKeywords` ability; keep them only in `keywords`.

The condition for "Lesson (5)" is incorrectly encoded as `conditionAny` of 5 Cute / 5 Cool / 5 Passion in cemetery. It should be a Lesson(5) condition, then destroy each enemy card on the field. Implement a Lesson condition type (or equivalent iM@S lesson-counter/check support) and use that instead.
The card has `keywords: ["fanfare"]`, but Fanfare should be represented by the ability timing only, not as a keyword.

The Fanfare text is flavor text and should not be encoded as a gameplay ability with `noop`. Remove the `noop` ability entirely; if flavor/support text retention is needed, implement a non-rules metadata field rather than an ability op.
The card has `keywords: ["fanfare"]`, but Fanfare should not be listed in `keywords`; there is no implementable rules effect here.

The final zone for the non-summoned cards is wrong. "Bury the rest" should put the remaining looked-at cards into the cemetery, not the bottom of the deck; replace `remainderTo: "deckBottom"` with cemetery handling.

The card has `keywords: ["fanfare", "rush"]`, but Fanfare is not a keyword and Rush is conditional rather than always printed. Remove these from `keywords` and keep the conditional Rush/Bane only in the passive ability.

The Last Words cost reduction is applied to `targets: {"type":"self"}` after moving the card to EX area, but the source text gives the moved card in EX area "This costs 1 less to play." Encode the reduction so it applies to this card in EX area / future plays of this card, not a field self-target buff.
The card has `keywords: ["evolve", "fanfare"]`, but neither Evolve nor Fanfare should be listed as keywords. Keep `evolveCost: 1` and the Fanfare ability only.

The On Evolve target filter is too narrow. The source says "Select a Machina card that costs 2 or less in your cemetery," not a follower specifically; remove `cardType: "follower"` from the cemetery filter.

The condition for "If there are no cards in your EX area" is encoded incorrectly as `exAreaTraitMin` with empty trait and count 0. This should be an EX-area-empty condition. Implement a condition such as `exAreaCount`/`exAreaMax`/`exAreaEmpty` and use it here.
The card has `keywords: ["fanfare"]`, but it has no Fanfare; remove that keyword.
